description: Allergen flags in an ingredient list (EU Annex II, US FALCPA + FASTER Act) — Scans an ingredient list for terms tied to the 14 allergens of EU Regulation 1169/2011 Annex II and the 9 US major food allergens (FALCPA plus sesame under the FASTER Act), for an agent or buyer checking a label or recipe. Returns each matched span with its character offsets, the allergen, the regime that lists it, and whether it sits in a 'may contain' clause. Pass the allergens a label declares

declared.description: Allergen keys the label declares. Any detected, non-precautionary allergen missing from this list fails. For jurisdictions=eu, wheat and gluten-cereal cover each other (one Annex II entry).

extraTerms.description: Caller synonyms (for example a brand's own ingredient name), matched as literal words.

ingredients.description: Ingredient list or label text, at most 20000 characters.

jurisdictions.description: Which list(s) to apply. Default both. EU adds celery, mustard, lupin, molluscs, sulphites and gluten cereals (rye, barley, oats); the US list has no such entries.

name: allergen-flag
